title: Maho transcript CoS operationalization defect
summary: Todd tested RB behavior after analyzing two Maho strategic calls: April 22 introductory/background discussion and April 29 product walkthrough/strategic discussion. The assistant gave high-quality advisory synthesis and Tuesday meeting prep, but did not render canonical RB operational output: no persistence proof, no relationship mutation confirmation, no loop creation confirmation, no daily brief injection confirmation, and no traceable CoS action report.
observed_issue: Good advice was produced without proving RB captured, persisted, scheduled, or operationalized the relationship intelligence.

steps.label: April 22 introductory/background call analyzed
steps.user_prompt: Analyze April 22 Maho call covering Todd's restaurant operations and enterprise tech background, McDonald's deployments, PAR leadership, franchise/franchisor adoption complexity, enterprise customization, AI coding impact on POS, industry consolidation, custom platform opportunities, education-led GTM, and Maho positioning.
steps.assistant_response: Assistant synthesized the call and recognized strong strategic validation, philosophical alignment, requested guidance around market approach, and rapid movement into strategic advisory territory.
steps.response_summary: Useful advisory analysis; no confirmed RB persistence, relationship mutation, active-thread update, or loop creation was shown.
steps.observed_issue: The call was early-stage strategic evaluation, not casual networking, but RB did not render an operational capture report.

steps.label: April 29 product walkthrough/strategic call analyzed
steps.user_prompt: Analyze April 29 Maho product walkthrough covering franchise architecture, inventory/recipe management, loyalty, KDS/POS synchronization, enterprise scalability, onboarding/service model, customization strategy, GTM packaging risk, and operator adoption concerns.
steps.assistant_response: Assistant correctly identified substantial strategic feedback, including flexibility vs clarity, onboarding/service monetization, enterprise positioning, education-driven GTM, and Ish's explicit request: 'We should have one call just focused on you.'
steps.response_summary: Useful strategic interpretation; no confirmed RI event, opportunity-stage update, relationship-risk tracking, or future meeting prep loop was shown.
steps.observed_issue: The assistant recognized the signal but did not prove operational continuity.

steps.label: Tuesday meeting prep generated
steps.user_prompt: Prepare for Tuesday Maho strategy/background discussion after Todd responded to Ish by email and the meeting was booked.
steps.assistant_response: Assistant prepared strong Tuesday framing: do not restart background, position Todd as operator-fluent enterprise strategist/adoption and GTM translator/franchise complexity expert, watch for advisory/partnership/executive interest, and protect against free consulting drift.
steps.response_summary: Advisory quality was high, but no Tuesday prep loop creation, daily brief injection, or persistence status was confirmed.
steps.observed_issue: RB behaved like a smart advisor instead of an auditable Chief-of-Staff operating system.

steps.label: Expected canonical RB output
steps.assistant_response: Expected canonical output should have said: 'Relationship intelligence detected — RB recorded the following...' and then rendered entity updates, relationship state, opportunity stage, signal strength, risk, recommended posture, next actions, persistence state, loop state, daily brief injection, and traceability.
steps.response_summary: Expected writes or proposed writes: update Ish Singh / Maho relationship state to active strategic opportunity, track advisory/consulting risk, create high-priority Tuesday prep loop, inject Tuesday Maho meeting prep into daily brief, and record persistence status.
steps.observed_issue: RB must separate advice from system action; vague language like 'should be marked', 'would likely', and 'could be' is not acceptable without persistence status.

defects.title: High-quality advice did not become RB system action
defects.description: The assistant synthesized the Maho calls well but did not prove that RB persisted relationship intelligence, updated opportunity state, created loops, or injected future prep into the daily brief.
defects.recommendation: Every RI-bearing transcript or strategic call analysis must end with an explicit RB operational report: analysis_only, proposed_write_pending_confirmation, or persisted.

defects.title: No persistence status or mutation proof rendered
defects.description: The response did not state whether Ish/Maho relationship intelligence was recorded, proposed, skipped, or blocked.
defects.recommendation: Mandate 'Relationship intelligence detected — RB recorded/proposed/skipped the following' with persistence status, affected entities, source refs, and post-validation state.

defects.title: Future meeting prep loop not confirmed
defects.description: The booked Tuesday Maho meeting should have created or confirmed an open high-priority prep loop with dependencies around positioning narrative, opportunity qualification, and free-consulting boundary.
defects.recommendation: Transcript/meeting analysis should propose or create a dated prep loop for future commitments and meetings.

defects.title: Tuesday daily brief injection was not confirmed
defects.description: The Maho meeting should have been queued for Tuesday's daily brief with relationship status, objective, expected takeaways, risks, desired posture, and commercial implications.
defects.recommendation: Add a daily brief injection/agenda-prep queue for future meetings and high-priority loops.

defects.title: Opportunity state and risk tracking missing
defects.description: The Maho thread had clear opportunity state: active strategic opportunity, advisory interest increasing, and unpaid consulting drift risk.
defects.recommendation: Active threads need opportunity stage, temperature, risk, commercial posture, next action, waiting-on, and evidence fields.

defects.title: Non-committal system-action language erodes trust
defects.description: Language like 'should be marked', 'would likely', and 'could be' blurs advice and action. The user needs proof of what RB actually did.
defects.recommendation: Use canonical wording: 'Relationship intelligence detected — RB recorded/proposed/skipped the following...' and separate advice from system action.

raw_text: User-provided RB 9.0 / CoS Canonical Behavior Test Summary — Maho Relationship Intelligence & Tuesday Prep Injection. Raw call transcripts were not included in this trace; this trace preserves the operator-provided test summary and architectural findings.
